{"CommandLine":".\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "
from typotaker.infer import load_run, _invert_maps
import torch
model, tok = load_run('checkpoints/gec_stage2_v4', 'data/tokenizer/tokenizer.json')
text = 'This is teh final document.'
ids = tok.encode(text, add_special=True)
pieces = tok.token_strings(text, add_special=True)
chars = tok.char_ids_for_tokens(pieces)
device = next(model.parameters()).device
logits = model.forward(torch.tensor([ids], device=device), torch.tensor([chars], device=device), task='gec', pad_id=tok.pad_id)['edit_logits'][0]
probs = torch.softmax(logits.float(), dim=-1)
for i, (tid, piece) in enumerate(zip(ids, pieces)):
    topk_v, topk_i = torch.topk(probs[i], 5)
    print(f'Token {i}: id={tid} piece={repr(piece)} top5={[ (int(idx), round(float(val), 4)) for val, idx in zip(topk_v, topk_i) ]}')
